headline: Webbie Collapsed During Boosie Performance: Akademiks Reports
body: DJ Akademiks reports Webbie collapsed while performing with Boosie on stage yesterday, describing it as a 'scary situation' where he 'shook back.' The post, shared on Instagram with 4,581 likes and 496 comments, states reports indicate Webbie experienced a sudden medical episode during the live show. No official medical details or cause have been confirmed by the artists or their teams.
